title: Director of Risk Management
description:
Director of Risk Management (Insurance Renewals)
Miami, Florida -Hybrid Work Environment

ARC Group is seeking a highly skilled Director of Risk Management to join our client's dynamic Risk Management team in Miami, FL. This is a full-time, direct hire position, offering an excellent opportunity for career growth in a
well-established Fortune 500 company with over 5,000 employees across North America and LATAM.

As the Director of Risk Management, you will play a key role in managing the company’s comprehensive insurance programs, including liability, property & casualty, auto, and group insurance. Your experience with corporate insurance renewals will be essential in ensuring the organization’s risk strategies are both effective and efficient.

Key responsibilities include maintaining and strengthening the company’s risk management framework, overseeing the bond and surety program, and ensuring compliance with applicable regulations. In this position, you will act as a strategic advisor within the organization, proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks.

This opportunity offers a healthy work/life balance, a culture of long-term employee retention, and a clear path for career advancement. ARC Group has been recognized as one of the top companies to work for, and we are committed to promoting from within.
 
​​​​​​You have permanent US work authorization.  We are not accepting resumes from outside firms  or vendors ( no C2C, 3rd party or brokering).
 
DIRECTOR OF RISK MANAGEMENT JOB DESCRIPTION
Implement risk mitigation and remediation strategies while proactively identifying, reducing, and transferring risks. Oversaw corporate risk management framework, insurance claims, and partnerships with internal clients, brokers, and providers to ensure alignment with company objectives.

RESPONSIBILITIES 
  • Designs and implements an overall risk management process for the company, including an analysis of the financial impact on the company and subsidiaries when risks occur.
  • Selects most effective and appropriate brokerages on behalf of the organization.
  • Analyzes and assesses insurance policies to ensure company needs are sufficiently covered.
  • Negotiates with insurance brokers and insurance carriers for best insurance rates.
  • Oversee claims and settlement values; analyze other sources of insurance that could possibly cover a claim.
  • Maintain and cultivate an environment of risk awareness and policies and procedures to promote risk reduction.
  • Formulates, develops, and coordinates loss control functions of the organization.
  • Maintains records of insurance policies and claims.
  • Prepares risk management and insurance budgets.
  • Prepares and presents comprehensive risk assessment reports.
  • Creates reports so that internal stakeholders understand how risk affect their operations.
  • Manages the captive insurance administration of workers' compensation claims, general liability, and auto,.
  • May be called upon for to vet company contracts to identify potential risk issues.

  • And here is what you will need to be successful:

    MUST HAVE SKILLS For Director of Risk

  • 8 or more years of Risk Management experience with at least 5 years in leadership roles
  • Experience in both a brokerage and corporate risk management environment is required
  • Safety and insurance risk management is helpful
  • Bachelor's Degree required, Master's degree is preferred
  • Strong math and computer skills, including Microsoft Office.
  • Database use and management experience.
  • Keen eye for details and exceptional problem-solving skills.
  • MUST be able to work in the US without any kind of sponsorship
NICE TO HAVE SKILLS For DIRECTOR OF Risk Management
  • Risk Manager certification
  • Local candidates preferred, but will consider relocation for the right candidate
Would you like to know more about this role? For immediate consideration, please send your resume directly to D.A. Longhi at dlonghi@arcgonline.com or call him at  (904)289-8828, or you can also apply online and view all our open positions at www.arcgonline.com.

title: Pool Maintenance Technician
description:
Pool Maintenance Technician
Jacksonville, Florida 32228

ARC Group is recruiting a Pool Maintenance Technician for Paddock Construction Co., Inc., supporting operations at their Mayport pool. This is a hands-on, direct hire role responsible for maintaining clean, safe, and fully operational swimming pool systems. The ideal candidate will be disciplined, technically skilled, and able to manage chemical control, equipment maintenance, and detailed documentation required for government standards and occasional government audits.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate, maintain, and clean pool equipment, including robotic vacuums
  • Handle and maintain CO2 tanks safely
  • Conduct pool testing three times daily and record results accurately
  • Perform pump room and chemical room maintenance, including lubricating pumps, valves, and motors
  • Maintain detailed records and documentation
  • Troubleshoot and respond to equipment failures as needed

Schedule:
  • Full-Time Supervisor: 5:00 AM – 3:00 PM, 5 days/week

title: Mortgage Loan Officer | Plano, TX
description:
Mortgage Loan Officer
Plano, TX
 

ARC Group is seeking motivated Loan Officers to join our Fortune 500 client’s team in Plano, TX. This role involves providing exceptional customer service and expert mortgage guidance in a fast-paced call center environment. You will assist new and existing clients in exploring mortgage options for purchasing a home, refinancing, or obtaining a home equity line of credit.

Position Overview

The Loan Officer is responsible for answering inbound calls and initiating outbound outreach to help clients identify the most suitable financing solutions. This includes analyzing financial goals, recommending loan products, completing mortgage applications, collecting documentation, and keeping clients informed throughout the lending process.

This position is subject to SAFE Act registration requirements. All employees engaged in residential mortgage origination must register with the federal registry system and maintain good standing. Failure to meet SAFE Act requirements may result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver exceptional client care by actively listening and understanding client needs.

  • Handle inbound and outbound calls to provide guidance on mortgage products, refinancing, and home equity solutions.

  • Analyze financial and credit data to recommend appropriate lending options.

  • Submit mortgage applications and assist clients in gathering required documentation.

  • Maintain ongoing communication with clients, referral partners, and internal teams via phone, email, and messaging systems.

  • Follow defined lending processes, policies, and risk management guidelines.

  • Identify opportunities to recommend additional banking products or services through partner referrals.

Required Qualifications

  • 1+ year of sales and mortgage experience with a strong focus on relationship-building and client service.

  • Proven ability to assess client needs, recommend financial solutions, and promote alternative products.

  • Strong communication skills (verbal, written, and non-verbal) with a professional, confident presence over the phone.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and thrive in a high-volume environment.

  • Comfortable working weekends and/or extended hours as needed.

  • Technical aptitude to learn and navigate multiple platform systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to balance sales performance, operational risk, and client relationship care.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Contact center experience.

  • Knowledge of mortgage loan products (Conventional, Jumbo, Government).

  • Familiarity with FHA/HUD guidelines, underwriting, processing, and closing procedures.

  • Ability to analyze complex financial data and provide alternative financing solutions.

  • Strong consultative skills with the ability to ask key questions and uncover opportunities.

Core Competencies

Attention to Detail | Client Solutions Advisory | Customer Focus | Critical Thinking | Pipeline & Loan Management | Collaboration | Problem Solving | Referral Identification & Management | Credit Documentation

Education & Schedule

  • Education: High School Diploma or GED required.

  • Work Schedule: Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM (Central) with rotating Saturdays, 8:00 AM – 3:30 PM.

  • Training Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM (Central) for approximately 8 weeks (subject to change).

Charlotte, North Carolina | On-Site
